bio.text: Rick Jackson, a businessman and political newcomer, is the Republican nominee for Governor of Georgia in 2026, after defeating Lt. Gov. Burt Jones in the June 16 Republican runoff.
He built Jackson Healthcare, an Alpharetta-based medical staffing company, and began his business career in staffing in 1976 when he bought the secretarial staffing company where he worked.
Jackson grew up in Atlanta and attended David Lipscomb College (now Lipscomb University) in Nashville but did not finish.
He is married to Melody Moore Jackson, a Georgia Tech professor.
